name: View
label: View
description: Declarative multi-collection read endpoint. Composes link/list/aggregate sections under a single anchor (or unanchored). Seeded from `<appDir>/views/**.view.json`; admin UI stores overrides in this collection. Served at `GET /api/v1/view/:viewName(/:rootName)?` by a single generic router.

fields.label: Anchored
fields.description: When true the view requires a `:rootName` URL segment naming a `source.entity` document.

fields.label: Overridden
fields.description: Set true when admin UI edits a seeded view; boot skips re-seed for these.

fields.label: Source
fields.description: { entity, param } — root entity and which `params[]` entry binds the URL :rootName.

fields.label: Parameters
fields.description: Typed query-string parameters: [{ name, type, required?, default?, enum_values? }, ...]

fields.label: Sections
fields.description: Array of { key, kind, entity, ... } — discriminated by `kind` ∈ {link, list, aggregate}.
